features.full_entropy: Shannon entropy, nats, full normalized distribution at pH7.4
features.effective_state_number: exp(record full entropy), then average within compound
features.full_state_count: All enumerated states in full distribution, including zero occupancy
features.parent_is_dominant: first argmax of accepted frozen cache prior has index0; index0 must equal parent; per-compound fraction, mixed category if between0and1
features.neutral_fraction: Full net-zero formal-charge fraction (not locally uncharged proxy)
features.selected_retained_mass: Frozen accepted selected-set retained_mass_fraction, clip[0,1] then round12 to remove normalization epsilon only
features.external_nn_az: External max Morgan1024/radius2/chiral Tanimoto to complete AZ4200 parent space, not fold training-only

compound_estimand: Mean over all records of abs(prior-y)-abs(uniform-y); positive means weighting worse. Ensemble predictions already frozen.
compound_features: Arithmetic record means; state count and binary can become fractional. Preserve n_records, n_unique_parents and mixed-parent flag. No residual/extreme deletion.
full_parent_diagnostic: Also report parent equals full-distribution dominant_smiles using canonical isomeric SMILES; not primary accepted-candidate binary.
missingness: Keep every compound/record in tidy output. Per-feature finite pairs only; report missing counts. Unavailable full priors get NaN rather than fabricated confidence.

bootstrap.method: Percentile95% exact reranked Spearman on resampled compounds; external also sample all T60 connected components with replacement and retain all compound members/multiplicities. Component-bootstrap replicate statistic remains compound-weighted; variable total compound count.
bootstrap.invalid_draws: Constant resamples produce NaN; report valid count; flag if <95% valid. No p-value headline, no multiplicity-adjusted claim.
bootstrap.bin_effect: Compound-average delta; bootstrap both units as applicable, fixed bin boundaries, no re-estimation of cutpoints per draw.

bins.rule: Quartile cutpoints [0.25,0.50,0.75] by numpy linear quantile before response association; collapse duplicate cutpoints; endpoints (-inf,+inf) preserve extremes; right-closed intervals. Constant reference collapses to one bin.

reference.asap_external: az_logd compound features except external_nn_az uses external response-free features

bins.binary: parent_is_dominant categories no,yes,mixed; separately summarize. Spearman uses fraction across compounds.

ph_flanks.outputs: Full-dominant state change, mean-charge/net-zero/entropy difference, full-distribution total variation. Record/compound descriptive outputs only; no property predictions or pH-transfer validation. No alternate-pH model candidate selection.

limitations: All analyses exploratory after R5 outcomes known
Conditional on fitted models/fixed splits and upstream predictions; no causal mechanism claim
Entropy and exp(entropy) are related summaries, not independent evidence
T60 components are transitive fingerprint groups, not validated independent chemical series
public_adaptation: Historical exploratory plan adapted only for public metadata and removal of an unused training-source byte audit. Scientific definitions, seeds, draws and numerical inputs unchanged.
